title: Student-led protest returns to the center of national politics
detail: Across the year, campus-based mobilizations and public confrontation over rights, safety, and representation made youth politics central to the national conversation.

title: Quota Reform Movement spreads across universities
detail: Students mobilized around the demand to reform state job quotas, turning merit, fairness, and access to public employment into a major civic issue.

title: Safe Road Movement expands from grief into nationwide protest
detail: After two students were killed by a bus in Dhaka, school and college students transformed anger over road deaths into a broad demand for transport accountability.

title: Digital Security Act is enacted
detail: The new law intensified concerns over speech, journalism, online expression, and the state's power to monitor and prosecute digital activity.

title: 11th Parliamentary Election ends the year in deep controversy
detail: The Awami League won overwhelmingly, but opposition parties and rights observers raised serious concerns about the pre-election climate, violence, and credibility of the process.
